svg.title: Node.js Streams Fundamentals
svg.desc: Auto-playing 64s step-by-step explainer of "Node.js Streams Fundamentals" (from img_12.png). Each step is highlighted in turn with what happens, why it matters, missing concepts added in lime, and a Node.js code example. Hover to pause.
svg.text: Four types of stream, all instances of the EventEmitter class: examples, important events and important functions

g.text: What: Streams are instances of EventEmitter: they emit events like data, end, drain and
finish. There are four types: Readable, Writable, Duplex and Transform.
Why: Once you know the four types, every stream API in Node (files, HTTP, sockets, zlib,
Added: pipeline() for safe error handling, for await...of, Readable.from, objectMode, Web

What: Streams that are both readable and writable, like a TCP socket: you read what the
